text:
Report: Civilization dev Firaxis lays off a third of its staff

Firaxis, the 30-year-old studio behind the Civilization and XCOM franchises, is laying off a third of its staff, totalling 60 people, as reported by Bloomberg's Jason Schreier. Studio head Heather Hazen, who has lead it since 2023, will be leaving as part of the cuts.

author: GamesIndustry.biz
text:
Meet the company that finds Chinese game developers to work on Western IP

Earlier this month, Yodo1 Games announced a strategic digital licensing partnership with the American firm AMC Global Media, which is behind television series such as The Walking Dead and Anne Rice's Interview with the Vampire. Yodo1 is tasked with finding and supporting Chinese game developers and publishers in order to create video games based on AMC's franchises.

text:
UK tribunal dismisses £2bn PlayStation class-action suit which alleged unfair pricing over 30% cut on PlayStation Store

A long-running class action lawsuit alleging that Sony was engaged in monopolistic behaviour and unfair price-fixing on PlayStation games has been dismissed by the UK competition authorities, following a trial earlier this year.

Roblox launches creator program for devs to bring games to its platform for free

Roblox has launched a new creator program that lets developers convert existing games to its platform for free.

text:
Tanuki: Pon's Summer is hoping to be a "lovely little underdog" between Ocarina of Time and GTA 6

While most titles have fled the release period between the Ocarina of Time remake and this week's GTA 6, Denkiworks opted to release their debut title Tanuki: Pon's Summer right in the middle, rolling it out last week. It is, mostly, a deliberate decision.

Six European game workers' unions have published a manifesto examining the use of generative AI in the games industry and its implications.

Xbox's Project Helix "is not a PC that can also play console games"

Xbox VP of Next Generation Jason Ronald has clarified that Project Helix is "designed to be a console that is also capable of playing games, not a PC that can also play console games."

Lisbon-based Studio Bravarda closes down after failing to recoup dev costs on its most recent title, Extremely Powerful Capybaras

Indie developer Studio Bravada has announced its closure after its second title, Extremely Powerful Capybaras, failed to recoup development costs over three years.

text:
Newzoo: GTA 6 pre-orders are archetypal console players but overwhelmingly male; game will "grow the market rather than simply redistribute it"

GTA 6 preorders are from archetypal, high-spending console gamers, overwhelmingly male, and most have a history of spending on the franchise, according to data from Newzoo shared exclusively with GamesIndustry.biz ahead of the game's final release on Thursday.

Sensor Tower: GTA 6 pre-orders exceed $1.4bn, with 87% for the Ultimate Edition

Sensor Tower estimates Grand Theft Auto 6 has generated over $1.4 billion in pre-order revenue, with 87% of orders for the Ultimate Edition.
